targets.rawSql: select date_trunc('minute', recorded_at) as time, coalesce(sum((dimensions->>'server_error_count')::numeric) / nullif(sum(metric_value), 0), 0) as value from runtime_telemetry_metrics where metric_name = 'letbuyy.runtime.request' and runtime_name = 'api-gateway' and deleted_at is null group by 1 order by 1

select date_trunc('minute', recorded_at) as time, dimensions->>'cloudflare_queue_name' as metric, sum(metric_value) as value from runtime_telemetry_metrics where metric_name = 'letbuyy.queue.delivery.batch' and deleted_at is null group by 1, 2 order by 1

select date_trunc('minute', recorded_at) as time, dimensions->>'owner_runtime' as metric, max(metric_value) as value from runtime_telemetry_metrics where metric_name = 'letbuyy.replay.lag.seconds' and deleted_at is null group by 1, 2 order by 1

select date_trunc('minute', recorded_at) as time, percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by (dimensions->>'latency_ms')::numeric) as value from runtime_telemetry_metrics where metric_name = 'letbuyy.runtime.request' and runtime_name = 'api-gateway' and deleted_at is null group by 1 order by 1
